title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Tue, 10 Sep 2024

General: Implemented performance enhancements to video recording stability
Other: Bug Fixes] Resolved an issue where MV Snapshot API would return an image 5 seconds prior to the requested timestamp.
